content.short: Teller is a non-custodial lending protocol on Mantle enabling permissionless borrowing markets for any ERC20 token or NFT collateral.
content.description: Teller Finance is a decentralized lending protocol enabling permissionless borrowing against any ERC20 token or NFT (ERC721/ERC1155) collateral, unlike traditional lending protocols limited to blue-chip assets. Communities can create lending markets for any token, enabling long-tail asset borrowing without governance approval. The protocol matches lenders and borrowers through its lending book infrastructure on Mantle, supporting both fungible token and NFT collateral for unprecedented asset coverage.
